title: Decaying Transmission
description: A detuned sawtooth swarm climbs from sub-bass murk to a screaming full-spectrum riser while a degradation arc ramps distortion and pitch-mangling squiz, so a clean alien drone slowly corrodes into a broken, glitching transmission before resetting. Filter, drive and squiz all travel on prime-ish clocks so the corrosion never repeats the same way.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 c2>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .add(note(saw.slow(24).range(0, 36)))
    .detune(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .off(0.011, x => x.add(note(0.2)).gain(0.5))
    .off(0.019, x => x.add(note(-0.3)).gain(0.5))
    .lpf(saw.slow(16).range(180, 9000)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(8).range(1, 5)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.2)
    .distort(sine.slow(32).range(0, 6).mul(saw.slow(16).range(0.2, 1)))
    .squiz("<1 1 2 4>/8".mul(saw.slow(16).range(1, 2)))
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 5))
    .vib(sine.slow(7).range(2, 9)).vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .pan(sine.slow(9).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .room(0.4).delay("0.4:0.375:0.6")
    .attack(0.02).release(0.1)
    .gain(0.8)
)
